resolution.note: adopt --verify prints verify context and verify context setting lines

title: krn adopt --verify prints the first-turn token estimate and the settings that reduce it
body:
Why: Fable plan 1114c missing item. .krn/runs/context-baseline/first-turn.txt: projects without their own .claude spend 33-53k tokens on the first turn vs 22-27k in krn.
Outcome: adopt --verify reports an estimate of first-turn context (instruction files, skills, MCP servers listed) and names the settings that cut it.
Proof: fixture test; npm run fast PASS.
